text.text:
Perhaps one of the best cooked duck I've ever had!
This place is a hidden gem.
I appreciate when dishes take 30mins to cook, it really shows that they aren't cutting any corners by pre-cooking anything.

text.text: I am very glad I found this diamond. One of the best meal I had for my trip. I kicked myself for ordering a 10USD pumpkin soup but I am very delighted from the end result. Multiple layer of goodness could be felt across each spoonful of goodness. You first felt the creaminess then the sweetness of the pumpkin. Aroma oil of shallots kicks in following the savoury crisp of croutons accompanied with almonds slices favour. All in one go. As if your taste buds took the elevator. Sea urchin risotto is not my favourite as it's not full of favours. Although the scallops are very fresh. Everything was great. The chef is of skill.  Definitely on my return list.

text.text: Incredible french cuisine, the chef's work is so close to a French cooking chef. Everything was delicious, we got mushrooms salad that was perfectly dressed, a tasteful rib-eye and a wellington cooked to perfection. The staff is super prepared and kind, very efficient. Wellington has to be ordered in advance.
